children: said on Wednesday it would enter Venezuela through the acquisition of a controlling interest in the Bare Block, a heavy oil block in the Orinoco Oil Belt, in a  deal that will make Grupo Gilinski its controlling shareholder.
GeoPark will acquire a 95% stake in the company, which holds the asset, valuing the stock consideration at $12.22 per share.
